name: pi-t-plan
description: Implementation plan tracking for pi: auto-detects plans from model output, tracks progress live in a TUI widget, keeps a persistent plan.md, and exposes a plan_manager tool so the model can update the plan itself. Trimegisto mode classifies each task into t1/t2/t3 agent tiers; live HH:MM:SS timers for in-progress tasks. Trilingual (EN/ES/ZH Mandarin) fuzzy progress detection.
author: Javier Noguerol <https://github.com/noguerol>
